films.title: HARD RESET
films.description: Quasi Skateboards' 93-minute HARD RESET pairs a 25-minute nine-rider company video with an unusually deep hour of bonus material and outtakes. Will Rosenstock and Jeremy Tubbs lead the film, Chad Bowers directs, and four explicitly billed guests expand the documented rider roster to 13.
creditNotes: Quasi's official upload supplies the nine-name starring bill, four named guests and the complete direction, principal filming, additional filming, color, photography, design and staff credits.
SkateVideoSite independently classifies HARD RESET as a 93-minute full-length, confirms all 13 rider appearances and preserves the same production credits.
Vague independently repeats the complete starring, guest and production billing; Quartersnacks documents the film's release and return-to-form context.
locations: New York City, New York, USA
films.locationNote: SkateVideoSite explicitly catalogs Montréal, Richmond and New York City and identifies both United States and Canadian production geography.
films.historicalContext: Presented by Quasi as 'A Return to Form,' HARD RESET reasserted the veteran company's team identity while pairing the concise main video with roughly an hour of raw footage, bonus material and outtakes.
films.artworkNotes: The exact official upload's 1920x1080 YouTube max-resolution thumbnail was visually reviewed on 2026-09-16. It is a dedicated Quasi HARD RESET title collage from the authorized complete film and contains no trailer, episode or event labeling.

films.title: MUTATE OR DIE
films.description: Heroin Skateboards' 26-minute MUTATE OR DIE is a years-in-the-making team full-length led by seven principal parts and a shared Charlie Gush, Dead Dave and Paul Kirts section. The full documented credits retain 26 skater appearances and 21 additional production contributors without collapsing the supporting montage names into the principal bill.
creditNotes: Heroin's official upload identifies the seven principal parts and music sequence; the company's first-party release essay explains Fos's multi-year production and editing decisions, including Paul Kirts joining the Charlie Gush and Dead Dave shared section.
SkateVideoSite independently classifies the film as a 26-minute full-length, credits Fos as filmmaker and catalogs all 26 skater appearances plus 21 production contributors.
Principal parts, the shared-part addition and wider team/montage appearances remain separately labeled rather than presented as equivalent roles.
films.locationNote: SkateVideoSite explicitly catalogs Los Angeles and United States/United Kingdom production geography; Heroin's first-party essay identifies Los Angeles and San Bernardino trip footage but does not support narrower UK city claims.
films.historicalContext: Fos described MUTATE OR DIE as a project built over several years and a deliberate callback to Heroin's earliest videos. The film introduced Hayate Kamimura, Jojo Ducros and Terry Kraus to the squad, promoted Hayate as the company's new professional and gave Nolan Houghton the closing part.
premiereNotes: Heroin completed a run of screenings before releasing the full film online after its final Tony's Saloon event with Pizzanista.
films.artworkNotes: The exact official upload's 1920x1080 YouTube max-resolution thumbnail was visually reviewed on 2026-09-16. It is a dedicated black, white and fluorescent-green Heroin MUTATE OR DIE title card with no trailer, episode or event labeling.

films.title: SORCERY
films.description: Blood Wizard's sixth full-length blends a seven-name first-party billing with independently documented appearances by Christian Holt and Riley 'The Yote' Willey, whose mini-part follows the credits. Chris Gregson filmed and edited the 33.5-minute team video, preserving nine supported rider appearances in total.
creditNotes: Blood Wizard's official upload identifies seven featured riders, calls SORCERY the company's sixth full-length and formally credits Chris Gregson with filming and editing.
SkateVideoSite independently classifies the film as a 34-minute full-length and adds Christian Holt to the documented company roster.
Lowcard independently confirms the principal bill, Chris Gregson's filming/editing credit and Riley 'The Yote' Willey's post-credits mini-part; the three credit groups preserve those distinctions.
films.locationNote: SkateVideoSite catalogs Blood Wizard as a United States company film. No narrower comprehensive filming-location list is asserted from the footage or artwork alone.
films.historicalContext: SORCERY is Blood Wizard's sixth full-length. Contemporary distributor coverage framed it around four newer riders—Ao Nishikawa, Cameron Parkinson, Evan Dineen and Asahi Kaihara—alongside returning team figures, while independent coverage singled out Ao's closing section and Riley Willey's post-credits mini-part.
films.artworkNotes: The exact official upload's 1920x1080 YouTube max-resolution thumbnail was visually reviewed on 2026-09-16. It is dedicated Blood Wizard SORCERY artwork built from an action sequence and the film title, with no trailer, episode or event labeling.
